Gut.name: Gut
Gut.description: Types that react first from instinct and a sense of their own boundaries, often around anger, whether shown, held in or numbed.

Heart.name: Heart
Heart.description: Types concerned with how they are seen and valued by others, and with who they really are.

Head.name: Head
Head.description: Types that meet the world through thinking and anticipation, often responding to uncertainty or anxiety.

hornevian.groupNote: How each type tries to get its needs met, after Karen Horney's three moves: toward, against and away from people.

Assertive.name: Assertive
Assertive.description: Pursue what they want directly and expect others to adapt.

Compliant.name: Compliant
Compliant.description: Meet their needs by living up to standards, duties or the expectations of others.

Withdrawn.name: Withdrawn
Withdrawn.description: Step back into their inner world to find what they need.

harmonic.groupNote: How each type responds when things go wrong or don't meet its needs.

Positive outlook.name: Positive outlook
Positive outlook.description: Look on the bright side and play down problems, their own and others'.

Competency.name: Competency
Competency.description: Set feelings aside and deal with the problem logically and effectively.

Emotional realness.name: Emotional realness
Emotional realness.description: Respond with strong feeling first and want others to respond to theirs.

instincts.groupNote: Three areas of life everyone attends to, one usually more than the others. Combined with a type they give the instinctual subtypes, which this package does not describe.

sp.name: Self-preservation
sp.description: Security, comfort, resources and practical matters for oneself and one's household.

so.name: Social
so.description: Belonging, standing and roles in groups and communities.

sx.name: One-to-one
sx.description: Intense connection and chemistry with particular people or interests.
